type Left = NoInfer<true> | false;
type Right = true | NoInfer<false>;
type Both = NoInfer<true> | NoInfer<false>;
type Mixed = (NoInfer<true> | 1) & any & object;
const a: Left & any & null = 1;
const b: Right & any & null = 2;
const c: Both & any & null = 3;
const d: Mixed = 4;
console.log(a, b, c, d);

type Brand = string & { tag: 1 };
type Shapes = { left: number } | { right: string };
type Meet<A, B, C> = A & B & C;
const branded: Meet<NoInfer<Brand>, any, number> = 5;
const structured: NoInfer<{ x: number }> & any & null = 6;
const shaped: NoInfer<Shapes> & { tag: 'ok' } = { right: 'r', tag: 'ok' };
console.log(branded, structured, shaped.tag);
